# PR type
- [ ] Bug Fix
- [ ] New Feature
- [x] Document Updates
- [ ] More Models or Datasets Support

# PR information

Fixes #10419

Correct the Chinese and English Qwen3.8-Flash-Next introductions: the 51B N-gram embedding table and 4B MTP module are additional to the 125B parameters, with about 6B activated per token. This follows the [official model overview at a fixed revision](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next/blob/de4b8e4d43b917e7706784d8bb445c9af86a3540/README.md#model-overview).

AI assistance was used to prepare this documentation change.

## Experiment results

Documentation only. Compared both introductions with the fixed official model card. `pre-commit run --files docs/source/BestPractices/Qwen3_8-Flash-Next-Best-Practice.md docs/source_en/BestPractices/Qwen3_8-Flash-Next-Best-Practice.md` passed all four applicable document hooks. On the exact published head `534ccb28f7014dcf7a0a64d4d0429b9d58b27175`, `pre-commit run --all-files` also passed all 10 configured hooks (flake8, isort, yapf and repository hygiene checks), with a clean worktree afterward. The fixed official model card was fetched again and matched the previously verified bytes. Rendered documentation build and model tests were not run; no runtime code or dependencies changed.

# Checklist

- [x] I have linked the related issue above, if there is one.
- [ ] I have reviewed and understand every changed line, and I can explain how the change works and why it is correct.
- [ ] I have run the relevant tests or reproductions locally, and included the commands and results above (if applicable).
- [ ] I am responsible for the content of this PR, regardless of how it was produced.
